    The extended Dynkin quiver of type E₆~ #

    The quiver LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE6 has a centre and three arms of two vertices each: for i : Fin 3 an outer vertex outer i with one arrow into the inner vertex inner i, which has one arrow into the centre. Its underlying graph is the extended Dynkin diagram E₆~, the star with three arms of length two, on seven vertices, here with every arrow pointing towards the centre. On the root-system side this is the star LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.starCartanMatrix ![2, 2, 2], whose Cartan matrix is not of finite type (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.not_isFiniteType_affineE₆).

    This file carries the vertex and arrow data, and the shape of the underlying graph: it is a tree, with at most one arrow between any two vertices, because every vertex is the source of at most one arrow and every arrow points towards the centre. The representation theory, that the quiver has infinite representation type, is in LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.RepresentationTheory.Quiver.AffineE6.FiniteRepType.

    Main definitions #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE6: the vertex type, with constructors center, inner and outer, and a Quiver instance.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE6.vertexEquiv: the vertices as Unit ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 3, so that there are seven of them (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE6.card_eq).
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE6.outerArrow and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE6.innerArrow: the arrow from an outer vertex to the inner vertex of its arm, and the arrow from an inner vertex into the centre.

    References #

    • I. Assem, D. Simson, A. Skowroński, Elements of the Representation Theory of Associative Algebras, Volume I, Chapter VII.

    Type

    The extended Dynkin quiver E₆~: a centre and three arms, each an outer vertex with an arrow into an inner vertex, which has an arrow into the centre.

    • center : AffineE6

      The centre, the head of the three inner arrows.

    • inner (i : Fin 3) : AffineE6

      The inner vertex of the arm indexed by i, adjacent to the centre.

    • outer (i : Fin 3) : AffineE6

      The outer vertex of the arm indexed by i, the tail of a single arrow.
